d:
With Champaklal away on pilgrimage, Jethalal and Tapu pass the evening competing to blow their front hair up in the air. Daya acts as the referee and announces Ahmedabad-trip stakes. Tapu wins easily, while Jethalal jokes that losing to his son feels like winning.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
